blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.
blocks.zh: 交互式视频到视频应用需要实时生成,同时保持远程时间一致性. 然而,最近的方法通过将注意力限制在一个固定长度的因果窗口来实现速度. 这限制了在相关历史超出上下文窗口时的远程一致性。 为了解决这一局限性,我们采用了基于简单观察的基于通信的方法。 视频到视频翻译提供了明确的跨框架参考:输入视频中匹配的区域在输出视频中也应当匹配. 具体地说,我们在输入中计算补丁级的函证,指导相应地区以前生成的输出的检索,并通过函证交叉注意在这些补丁上附加模型. 我们的实验表明,vid2vid-long在保持生成质量和实时性能的同时,不断提高近期视频模型的长距离时间一致性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Real-time video-to-video translation unlocks a large class of interactive applications, including streaming, gaming, and augmented and virtual reality.
Recent advances in large scale text-to-video diffusion models [ 41 , 57 , 31 , 1 , 16 , 6 ] , and subsequently
distilling them into few-step, autoregressive models [ 51 , 12 , 47 , 22 , 20 ] , have enabled high-quality generation at interactive speeds.
blocks.zh:
实时视频到视频翻译解锁了一大批交互式应用程序,包括流线,游戏,以及增强和虚拟现实.
大规模文本到视频传播模型的最新进展[41、57、31、1、16、6],随后
将它们蒸馏成几步,自相递进的模型[51,12,47,22,20],使得能以交互速度进行高质量的生成.

blocks.en:
Autoregressive video generation relies on a history of past frames to ensure temporal continuity. However, determining an efficient mechanism for maintaining this history remains a fundamental challenge.
Naïvely retaining all past outputs causes memory to scale linearly and runtime quadratically with sequence length, both of which are prohibitive for real-time applications.
To maintain real-time latency, many methods resort to a fixed-length sliding window.
While this ensures a fixed memory and runtime per frame, it fundamentally sacrifices long-range consistency: once an object leaves the window, often after only a few seconds, the model “forgets” it forever.
blocks.zh:
自动回放视频生成依赖于过去帧的历史,以确保时间连续性. 然而,确定维持这一历史的有效机制仍然是一个根本挑战。
保留过去的所有产出,会使内存按照顺序长度线性地和运行时间四倍地缩放,这对实时应用来说都是令人望而却步的。
为了保持实时耐用性,许多方法都采用固定长的滑动窗口.
虽然这保证每个帧都有固定的内存和运行时间,但它从根本上牺牲了长距离的一致性:一旦一个物体离开窗口,往往只过了几秒钟,模型就永远"忘记"了.

blocks.en: Several lines of work have attempted to bridge this gap. First, attention sinks [ 45 , 47 , 22 , 38 ] heuristically retain the initial frames as a global anchor.
blocks.zh: 几行工作试图弥合这一差距。 首先,注意力沉入[45、47、22、38]全神贯注地保留初始框架作为全球锚地。

blocks.en: However, this approach inherently cannot address novel content that first appears in a later frame, even in cases like simple disocclusions. Another approach involves models with learned hidden states, such as Mamba [ 8 , 4 ] , which compress history into fixed-size bottlenecks. While efficient, these models often forgo the expressive power of transformers and remain largely limited to scenes with lower temporal complexity [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,这种方法本身不能处理最初出现在后方框架的新内容,即使是在简单的分离情况下也是如此。 另一种方法涉及具有所学得的隐藏状态的模型,如曼巴[8,4]将历史压缩为固定大小的瓶颈. 这些模型虽然效率很高,但往往放弃了变压器的表达力,基本上仍然局限于时间复杂性较低的场景[32].

blocks.en: Finally, some methods use pose conditioning [ 52 ] or explicit world representation (e.g., 3D point clouds) to maintain a consistent world [ 46 , 42 ] . These methods struggle to model dynamic scenes and require additional privileged inputs that are hard to obtain.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了维持一个一致的世界[46,42],有些方法提出了条件[52]或明确的世界代表性(例如3D点云). 这些方法为模拟动态场景而挣扎,需要更多的难于获得的特权投入.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we address the challenge of long-range consistency in video-to-video translation.
Our insight is that long-range consistency cues are provided in the input video itself.
That is, if two regions match in the input video, their generated outputs should match as well.
The input space can therefore serve as an index for retrieving previously generated content, allowing consistency to be enforced, without requiring access to the full output history.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们讨论了视频到视频翻译方面远距离一致性的挑战。
我们的见解是,输入视频本身提供了远程一致性提示。
也就是说,如果输入视频中有两个区域匹配,它们产生的产出也应当匹配。
因此,输入空间可以作为检索以前生成的内容的索引,允许执行一致性,而不需要访问完整的输出历史.

blocks.en:
As such, we introduce vid2vid-long , a correspondence-based dynamic memory mechanism that enables long-term consistency while preserving real-time performance.
Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input video and use them to index a compressed global representation of prior outputs.
This representation grows only when novel content appears, rather than with video length, resulting in sub-linear memory growth in practice.
The approach is complementary to existing autoregressive distillation backbones.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们引入了vid2vid-long-,一种基于通信的动态内存机制,它既能实现长期一致性,又能保持实时性能.
具体地说,我们在输入视频中计算补丁级的函文,并用它们来索引以前产出的压缩全球表现。
这种表现只有在新内容出现时,而不是随着视频长度而增长,导致实践中的子线性记忆增长.
这种方法是对现有自旋蒸馏骨干的补充。

blocks.en:
We evaluate our approach in combination with multiple autoregressive distillation frameworks, including Self-Forcing, LongLive, and Rolling Forcing.
In all settings,
incorporating
our technique substantially improves long-range consistency, while maintaining real-time inference speed and high visual quality.
Our main contributions are: • We identify a structural property of video-to-video translation: correspondences in input space induce correspondences in output space, enabling input-driven retrieval for long-range consistency. • We propose a correspondence-based mechanism that maintains a compressed global representation of prior outputs whose size scales with visual novelty rather than sequence length. • We demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range temporal coherence across multiple real-time autoregressive backbones. Our project website is available at https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~vid2vid-long/ .

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
The rapid advancements in text-to-image [ 34 , 18 , 44 ] and text-to-video [ 1 , 41 , 10 ] have been accompanied by controllable adapters that allow a more fine-grained control over the generation.
In the image domain, works like ControlNet [ 54 ] , Sketch-Guided-Diffusion [ 40 ] , T2I adapter [ 25 ] , img2img-turbo [ 28 ] show the ability to add structure control like edge maps, depth maps, and hand drawn sketches.
Models such as IP-adapter [ 48 ] , BLIP-diffusion [ 19 ] , SynCD [ 17 ] , VisualComposer [ 29 ] show ability to condition the generation of subject identity.
These methods have also been extended to videos in recent methods like ControlVideo [ 56 ] , Control-A-Video [ 3 ] , VACE [ 14 ] , and COSMOS-T [ 26 ] .
However, existing video control methods are primarily designed for offline generation, often relying on non-causal processing that makes them unsuitable for interactive applications.
We aim to address this gap in this paper.
blocks.zh:
在文本到图像[34,18,44]和文本到视频[1,41,10]的快速进步中,还伴随着可控适配器,可以更精细地控制生成.
在图像域中,诸如ControlNet [54],Sketch-Guided-Diffusion [40],T2I适配器 [25],img2img-turbo [28] 等作品都显示能够像边缘地图,深度地图,和手绘草图一样添加结构控制.
例如IP-adapter [48],BLIP-Diffusion [19],SynCD [17],VisualComposer [29] 等模型显示具备条件生成主体身份的能力.
这些方法还被推广到近期的视频中,如ControlVideo [56],Control-A-Video [3],VACE [14],和COSMOS-T [26]等.
然而,现有的视频控制方法主要是为离线生成而设计的,往往依赖于非原因处理,使其不适合交互式应用.
我们的目标是在本文件中弥补这一差距。

blocks.en:
Several prior works have explored speeding up diffusion models by reducing the number of denoising steps. Initial image domain approaches like consistency models [ 39 ] , progressive distillation [ 35 ] , adversarial distillation [ 37 ] , and distribution matching distillation [ 50 , 49 ] , moment matching distillation [ 36 ] enabled high-quality inference in 1–4 steps.
Recent methods like CausVid [ 51 ] extend distillation to video generation, while Diffusion Forcing [ 2 ] explores autoregressive video generation. However, these approaches can still suffer from error accumulation during autoregressive inference.
To address this, Self-Forcing [ 12 ] trains the student model on its own generated rollout, rather than ground truth video.
Our work is complementary to these methods, focusing on maintaining long-range consistency during autoregressive inference.
blocks.zh:
以前的一些工作通过减少去名步骤来探索加速传播模式。 初始图像域接近一致性模型 [39],渐进式蒸馏 [35],对抗式蒸馏 [37],以及分布相匹配的蒸馏 [50,49],瞬间相匹配的蒸馏 [36] 使得在1–4步骤中能够进行高质量的推论.
CausVid等近代方法[51]将蒸馏推广到视频生成,而分泌活化活化[2]则探索自相递进取的视频生成. 然而,这些方法在自相递减的推论中仍然可能出现出错积累.
为了解决这个问题,"自强"[12]通过自己产生的"推出"来培训学生模式,而不是地面真实视频.
我们的工作是对这些方法的补充,侧重于在自动递归推断期间保持长期一致性。

blocks.en:
Maintaining long-term consistency in autoregressive generation is computationally challenging due to the quadratic complexity of transformer attention.
This is particularly severe for videos: five seconds of 480p video can exceed 32,000 tokens in modern architectures like WAN2.1 [ 41 ] .
Existing methods such as Streaming-T2V [ 11 ] or LongLive [ 47 ] typically use sliding windows or hierarchical latent memory.
However, these often suffer from recency bias, where the model forgets the appearance of objects or environments during loop closures or long-duration occlusions.
While the language modeling literature has explored KV cache pruning and compression [ 7 , 23 ] , these methods often ignore the spatiotemporal continuity of video.
blocks.zh:
由于变压器注意力的四相复杂,在自动递减生成方面保持长期一致性在计算上具有挑战性.
这对视频来说尤为严重:5秒480p视频在WAN2.1等现代建筑中可超过32,000个符. [41].
流出-T2V[11]或LongLive[47]等现有方法通常使用滑动窗口或分级潜在内存.
然而,这些经常会受到惯性偏差的影响,即模型在循环闭塞或长期闭塞时会忘记物体或环境的外观.
虽然语言建模文献探索了KV缓存穿行和压缩[7,23],但这些方法往往忽略了视频的瞬间连续性.

blocks.en: Rather than deciding which history to retain solely based on temporal position, learned compression, or token importance, we use input-space correspondences to retrieve the specific past outputs that are relevant to the current frame. This makes the memory mechanism task-aware and particularly well-suited to video-to-video translation, where repeated input regions should induce repeated output appearances.
blocks.zh: 我们不是仅仅根据时间位置、所学压缩或象征性重要性决定保留哪些历史,而是使用输入空间通信来检索与当前框架相关的过去具体产出。 这使得内存机制意识到任务,尤其适合视频到视频的翻译,重复输入区域会诱发重复输出出场.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our objective is to design an autoregressive video-to-video diffusion model equipped with a correspondence-based memory mechanism. Our architecture enables long-range temporal consistency while maintaining the low-latency performance required for real-time deployment. We begin by reviewing the autoregressive formulation in Section 3.1 . In Section 3.2 , we introduce our explicit correspondence-based memory component. We then detail our strategy for conditioning on this historical context in Section 3.3 . Finally, we describe the specific training objectives and real-time inference algorithm in Sections 3.4 and 3.5 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是设计一种自动回转的视频到视频传播模式,并配备基于通信的内存机制. 我们的架构能够保持时间上的长期一致性,同时保持实时部署所需的低纬度性能。 我们首先审查第3.1节中的自递性表述。 在第3.2节中,我们引入了基于通信的明确记忆部分。 然后,我们将在第3.3节中详细阐述我们根据这一历史背景制定的战略。 最后,我们分别在第3.4和3.5节中描述了具体的训练目标和实时推论算法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en:
Our method builds upon pre-trained flow-matching models designed for video-to-video translation. Specifically, we adopt VACE [ 14 ] , which is a latent flow-matching model, operating within the latent space of a pre-trained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) [ 34 ] .
Given a block of input frames 𝐈 ( b ) ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 \mathbf{I}^{(b)}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} , the VAE encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} maps the pixel data to a latent representation 𝐳 ( b ) ∈ ℝ t × h × w × c \mathbf{z}^{(b)}\in\mathbb{R}^{t\times h\times w\times c} .
The latent dimensions are determined by the spatial and temporal compression factors, which for VACE are given as follows: h = H / 8 h=H/8 , w = W / 8 w=W/8 , and t = 1 + ( T − 1 ) / 4 t=1+(T-1)/4 .
Following common practice in vision transformers [ 30 ] , the latent block is further patchified into a sequence of tokens.
Each latent frame is partitioned spatially into non-overlapping patches of size 1 × p × p 1\times p\times p , where the temporal dimension of a patch remains singular.
This process yields a total of N = t × ( h / p ) × ( w / p ) N=t\times(h/p)\times(w/p) tokens per block.
Specifically for VACE, p = 2 p=2 .

blocks.en:
For the generative model itself, VACE utilizes a bidirectional spatiotemporal transformer to generate an entire video at once.
This design implies that every generated token depends on the full context of the video, including both past and future tokens.
This design is expensive in computation and memory, limiting their operation to short, fixed-length sequences, typically up to five seconds.
blocks.zh:
对于基因模型本身,VACE使用双向瞬间变压器,同时生成一整段视频.
这种设计意味着每个生成的地标都取决于视频的全部背景,包括过去和未来的地标.
这种设计在计算和内存方面很昂贵,将其操作限制在短而固定的序列上,一般可长达5秒.

blocks.en:
To enable long-form generation, recent methods [ 51 , 12 , 47 , 22 ] replace bidirectional attention with causal attention.
These models generate videos autoregressively in temporal blocks, where each block 𝐳 ( b ) \mathbf{z}^{(b)} is generated by conditioning on the previously generated blocks 𝐳 ( < b ) \mathbf{z}^{(<b)} .
Access to previously generated blocks is typically implemented via a causal KV cache.
While theoretically sound, maintaining the entire history 𝐳 ( < b ) \mathbf{z}^{(<b)} causes the runtime to grow quadratically with the video length, and the memory usage linearly.
To ensure a constant per-frame runtime necessary for streaming applications, the causal attention is typically restricted to a smaller set of past frames, implemented with a sliding window of size W W .
Under this constraint, the generation of block b b conditions only on the most recent context 𝐳 ( b − W : b − 1 ) \mathbf{z}^{(b-W:b-1)} .
Although this approach bounds the computational cost, it fundamentally limits temporal consistency to the window size.
Any information that falls outside this window becomes inaccessible to the model, leading to identity drift and “forgetting” over long horizons.
Our method addresses this limitation by providing an explicit correspondence-based memory that allows any autoregressive model to access the history arbitrarily far beyond its fixed window.

这一窗口外的任何信息都无法进入模型,导致身份漂移并“忘记”了漫长的地平线。
我们的方法通过提供明确的基于通信的内存来解决这一限制,这种内存允许任何自发性模型任意地访问其固定窗口以外的历史。

blocks.en: 3.2 Compressed Patch History
blocks.zh: 3.2 压缩补丁历史

blocks.en:
In video-to-video translation, the availability of the input stream allows us to move beyond temporal proximity as the sole proxy for relevance.
While a sliding window approach utilizes only recent frames for context, we can use explicit correspondences in the input space to identify relevant history from any point in the past.
This is a reliable strategy because regions that match in the input video should match in the generated output (see Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh:
在从视频到视频的翻译中,输入流的可用性使我们能够超越时间相近,成为相关性的唯一代名词.
虽然滑动窗口方法只利用最近的背景框架,但我们可以在输入空间使用明确的函文,从过去的任何一点来识别相关的历史。
这是一项可靠的战略,因为输入视频中匹配的区域应当匹配生成的产出(见图2)。

blocks.en:
By explicitly hard-coding these correspondences, we offload the burden of discovery from the transformer’s expensive attention layers.
Rather than forcing the model to rediscover these relationships, we provide them directly via an external index.
We represent this memory as an evolving set of input-output pairs.
Each entry consists of a descriptor for an input patch, which acts as a retrieval key, and the corresponding generated output patch, which serves as the value for future conditioning.
To ensure the system remains scalable for long sequences, we only update the memory when the input video presents novel information.
If an incoming patch is already sufficiently represented in the history, we do not save it.
This ensures that the memory footprint scales with the visual novelty of the scene, rather than the raw sequence length. (See history growth analysis in the appendix.)
blocks.zh:
通过明确硬编码这些信件,我们卸下变压器昂贵的注意力层的发现负担。
我们不是强迫模型重新发现这些关系,而是通过外部指数直接提供。
我们代表这个内存,是一组不断演变的输入输出对.
每个条目由一个输入补丁的描述器组成,它起到检索键的作用,以及相应的被生成的输出补丁,它充当了未来条件的值.
为了保证系统对于长相序列仍然可伸缩,我们只有在输入视频呈现出新信息时才更新内存.
如果到来的补丁在历史上已经得到充分的体现,我们不会保存它.
这保证了记忆足迹会随着场景的视觉新奇而成规模,而不是生动的序列长度. (见附录中的历史增长分析。 )

blocks.en: To implement this mechanism, we define three concrete operations that govern the memory lifecycle. We first specify the patch-level representation for the keys and values, followed by the retrieval protocol for reading from history, and finally the novelty-based policy for writing to the global store.
blocks.zh: 为了实施这个机制,我们定义了三种具体操作,指导记忆生命周期. 我们首先指定了密钥和值的补丁级别代表,然后是从历史中读取的检索协议,最后是给全球商店写作的新颖政策。

blocks.en: Patch Descriptor.

blocks.en:
Our memory mechanism leverages the spatial discretization already present in the diffusion transformer (see Section 3.1 ).
In this framework, every input video spatiotemporal patch is already mapped to a small latent patch of shape ( 1 , 2 , 2 ) (1,2,2) that corresponds to a single token.
From here, we use term “latent patch” for these token-corresponding patches.
We assign each latent patch a global index g g that uniquely identifies its spatiotemporal coordinates.
For every input latent patch at index g g , denoted as 𝐳 g \mathbf{z}_{g} , we define a descriptor 𝐤 g \mathbf{k}_{g} to serve as a retrieval key.
We evaluated several feature extractors ϕ \phi to produce these keys, including external vision backbones applied in pixel space.
However, our experiments show that the most effective representation is the latent patch itself (further analysis is included in the appendix).
Consequently, we define the feature extraction function as the identity mapping, where 𝐤 g = 𝐳 g \mathbf{k}_{g}=\mathbf{z}_{g} .
This approach also avoids the computational cost of decoding latents back to pixels and the inference run of additional feature extraction backbones.
Under this formulation, the memory stores pairs ( 𝐤 g , 𝐯 g ) (\mathbf{k}_{g},\mathbf{v}_{g}) , where the key 𝐤 g \mathbf{k}_{g} is the input latent patch and the value 𝐯 g \mathbf{v}_{g} is the corresponding to the generated output latent patch.

blocks.en:
We incorporate our correspondence-based memory into several different autoregressive video model. Unless stated otherwise, we use Rolling Forcing [ 22 ] distillation with 5 steps as the default configuration.
The student model is initialized from pretrained VACE 1.3B and all model parameters are finetuned jointly, including the newly introduced correspondence cross-attention layers.
We adopt the standard Rolling Forcing objective without modification or extra loss terms.
The correspondence memory is active during training, and memory read and write operations are performed as described in Section 3.2 .
The student conditions on retrieved correspondences from its own previously generated blocks, and newly generated patches are written to memory according to the novelty threshold.
The teacher model is a bidirectional VACE 14B model and it does not use correspondence memory.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
Here, we first evaluate our method on depth-to-video translation, focusing on long-range temporal consistency on long videos. Our mechanism is agnostic to the conditioning modality.
Experiments are conducted on two benchmarks: VACE-Benchmark [ 14 ] , covering diverse real-world scenes, and DL3DV [ 21 ] , a geometry-grounded 3D dataset enabling controlled pose revisits.
We compare against bidirectional diffusion models, prior video translation methods, and recent autoregressive distillation approaches, and ablate the key components of our correspondence mechanism.
Unless stated otherwise, all experiments use VACE 1.3B at 480p resolution.
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们首先评估我们对深度到视频翻译的方法,重点是长视频的长距离时间一致性. 我们的机制对调节模式是不可知的。
实验在两个基准上进行:VACE-Benchmark [14],涵盖不同的现实世界场景;和DL3DV [21],一个几何定位的3D数据集,能被控制的姿势再现.
我们比较了双向传播模型、先前的视频翻译方法以及最近的自旋蒸馏方法,并降低了我们通信机制的关键组成部分。
除非另有说明,所有实验均以480p分辨率使用VACE 1.3B.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on two benchmarks.
VACE-Benchmark [ 14 ] contains diverse real-world video sequences with varying motion and scene complexity.
DL3DV [ 21 ] is a geometry-grounded 3D dataset with calibrated camera poses, enabling controlled evaluation of viewpoint revisits and long-range consistency.
Additional dataset details and preprocessing are provided in appendix.

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method in terms of video quality, long-range consistency under revisits, and inference efficiency.
Video quality is measured on full generated videos using V-Bench [ 13 ] metrics (subject consistency, background consistency, temporal flickering, motion smoothness, aesthetic quality, and imaging quality). Experiments report average of scores, individual metrics values are provided in the appendix.
Long-range consistency is evaluated using controlled revisit protocols that require model to reproduce previously observed content.
On VACE-Benchmark, following [ 9 ] , we construct synthetic long sequences by concatenating two distinct 5-second clips in an interleaved order (A→B→A→B), and measure reconstruction consistency between repeated occurrences of the same clip.
Consistency is quantified using LPIPS [ 55 ] , DreamSim [ 5 ] , and CLIP [ 33 ] image similarity.
On DL3DV, we use pretrained 3D Gaussian Splatting models [ 15 ] using calibrated camera poses to render exact pose revisits and measure consistency between first-visit and revisit frames.
We measure inference latency and throughput.
Inference latency is measured as time to produce first frame and throughput is reported in frames per second (FPS). All measurements are performed on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.

blocks.en: 4.1 Baseline Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.1 基线比较

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method against several video-to-video translation frameworks. Quantitative and qualitative results are in Table 1 and Figure 3 .
First, we compare to
Control-A-Video [ 3 ] , VideoComposer [ 43 ] , and ControlVideo [ 56 ] .

首先,我们比较一下
控制A-视频 [3],"视频编解" [43],"控制视频" [56].

blocks.en:
They operate in an offline bidirectional setting with multi-step diffusion and global attention over fixed-length sequences.
In our experiments, they produce lower visual quality and struggle to maintain long-range consistency (Figure 3 ).
ControlVideo achieves relatively strong reconstruction scores due to its hierarchical sampling strategy over long sequences.
However, this comes at the cost of high latency ( ≈ \approx 42 minutes in our setting) and reduced perceptual quality, making it impractical for real-time video-to-video translation.

在我们的实验中,它们产生更低的视觉质量并努力保持远程一致性(图3.
ControlVideo因其分级采样策略在长序上取得了相对强大的重建分数.
然而,这代价是长时间(在我们的环境下大约为42分钟),并且降低了感知质量,使得实时视频到视频翻译不切实际.

blocks.en:
We next compare to newer, state-of-the-art video translation models, such as VACE [ 14 ] .
As discussed before, VACE is a bidirectional model which is limited to a fixed-length, short video sequences.
Unfortunately, there is no publicly available adaption of VACE to an unbounded-length, streaming use case.
In order to still apply VACE on our setting, we adapt it in two manners.
blocks.zh:
接下来我们比较一下最新,最先进的视频翻译模型,比如VACE [14].
如前所述,VACE是一种双向模型,限于固定长短的视频序列.
遗憾的是,VACE没有可公开查阅的适应无限制长度的流化使用案例。
为了在我们的环境下继续应用VACE,我们以两种方式加以调整.

blocks.en:
First, we directly evaluate VACE by applying it on non-overlapping video segments.
We find that this naive adaptation of VACE produces high-quality results, but unsurprisingly has poor long-range consistency.
For example, note row 2 in Figure 3 where each individual frame is of high-quality, but objects change their colors drastically over the length of the video.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们直接评估VACE,将它应用于非重叠视频部分.
我们发现VACE的这种天真适应产生了高质量的效果,但毫不出人意料的是,长距离一致性差.
例如,图3中的注行2,其中每个单个相框都具有高品质,但物体在视频长度上会急剧地改变颜色.

blocks.en:
Second, we adapt VACE to a streaming use-case with three recent causal, autoregressive distillation methods: Self-Forcing [ 12 ] , LongLive [ 47 ] , and Rolling Forcing [ 22 ] .
These methods were originally designed for text-to-video generation and aren’t applied to video-to-video yet.
Here, we implement and adapt the three methods to video-to-video with VACE.
We find that all methods achieve competitive quality scores and substantially lower latency than the bidirectional VACE baseline (Tables 1 , 2 ).
Nevertheless, these methods still perform poorly on long-range consistency.
On VACE-Bench, Self-Forcing and LongLive underperform bidirectional VACE, while Rolling Forcing only slightly outperforms it in long-range reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们调整VACE,使之适应流式使用案例,并采用最近三种因果自递式蒸馏方法: 自强出 [12],长活出 [47];自活出 [22].
这些方法最初是为文本到视频生成而设计的,目前还没有应用于视频到视频.
在这里,我们实施并修改了三种方法,与VACE进行视频对视频.
我们发现,所有方法都取得了有竞争力的质量分数,而且与VACE的双向基线相比,耐久性大大降低(表1和表2)。
然而,这些方法在长期一致性方面仍然表现不佳。
在VACE-Bench上,"自强"和"LongLive"的双向VACE表现不佳,而"滚出"的Forcing在远程重建中仅略胜.

blocks.en:
Our main contribution, correspondence mechanism, can be readily applied with any autoregressive method. In Table 1 , 2 and Figure 3 , we report results of our best configuration, where our method is applied with Rolling Forcing.
Among autoregressive methods, our approach achieves the strongest long-range consistency and visual quality while maintaining real-time performance.
In Table 3 , we report the results of our method when applied on top of all autoregressive methods.
Adding our correspondence mechanism consistently improves long-term consistency across all autoregressive backbones while preserving visual quality. Table 3 results demonstrate that our method is orthogonal to choice of autoregressive backbone.
Please refer to the appendix for a comparison of different conditioning mechanisms.

blocks.en: 4.2 Alternate Consistency Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 4.2 替代一致性机制

blocks.en:
We compare our correspondence mechanism against alternative strategies for extending temporal context beyond the default sliding window.
Qualitative and quantitative results are shown in Figure 4 and Table 4 , respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们比较我们的通信机制与将时间背景扩大到默认滑动窗口以外的其他战略。
定性和定量结果分别见图4和表4。

blocks.en:
We increase the sliding window size from 21 latent frames to 42 ( × 2 \times 2 ), 63 ( × 3 \times 3 ), and 84 ( × 4 \times 4 ).
On VACE-Bench, larger windows improve reconstruction consistency slightly, although the gains are non-monotonic.
However, on DL3DV, where sequences are substantially longer, performance degrades sharply in both quality and long-range consistency.
blocks.zh:
我们把滑动窗口大小从21个潜在框架增加到42个(x2\times 2),63个(x3\times 3),84个(x4\times 4).
在VACE-Bench上,较大的窗口稍微提高了重建的一致性,尽管收益是非莫名的.
然而,在DL3DV上,序列长得多,性能在质量和远距离一致性上都急剧下降.

blocks.en:
Next, instead of sliding window, we retain KV cache of every N N -th block ( N = 3 , 5 , 10 N{=}3,5,10 ), providing a sparse but more complete coverage of the history.
While this improves over simply enlarging the window, it remains worse than correspondence-based retrieval in long-range reconstruction (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们保留了每个N-th区块的KV缓存(N = 3, 5, 10 N{=}3, 5, 10), 提供了少量但更完整的历史报道.
虽然这比仅仅扩大窗口有所改进,但在远程重建中仍然比基于通信的检索更糟(表4)。

blocks.en:
We maintain a single block of KV tokens as a running cumulative average of all previous blocks, providing constant memory access to the entire history.
Although this improves long-range consistency on DL3DV degrades visual quality on both datasets (quality scores drop to 0.753 and 0.772).
blocks.zh:
我们维持了单个块的KV指使符,作为所有前作块的运行中累积平均值,为整个历史提供恒定的内存访问.
虽然这提高了DL3DV的远程一致性,但是在两个数据集上的视觉质量(质量分数下降到了0.753和0.772).

blocks.en:
To isolate the role of correspondence matching from the cross-attention layers, we replace the similarity-based retrieval with uniform random sampling from the memory bank.
Each query patch receives k k randomly selected history patches instead of the top- k k most similar, the history creation process remains the same.
This significantly degrades long-range reconstruction performance, demonstrating that accurate correspondence matching is essential.
blocks.zh:
为了从交叉切入层中分离出通信匹配的作用,我们用来自内存库的统一随机抽样取代了基于相似性的检索.
每个查询补丁收到k随机选择的k历史补丁,而不是最相近的上-克,历史创建过程保持不变.
这大大地降低了远程重建的性能,表明准确的通信匹配至关重要.

blocks.en:
Recent methods such as LongLive, MotionStream, and Rolling Forcing retain initial frames as an attention sink to provide global context.
However, this mechanism cannot capture novel content that appears later in the sequence and is insufficient to prevent identity drift in long videos.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法如"长活"(LongLive),"MotionStream"(MotionStream)和"滚出堡垒"(Rolling Forcing)保留了初始帧作为关注槽来提供全球背景.
然而,这种机制无法捕捉序列后期出现的新内容,不足以防止长视频中的身份漂移.

blocks.en:
FramePack [ 53 ] is applied to the task of video to video translation, storing past blocks at geometrically decreasing spatial resolution. Recent blocks maintain full resolution while older blocks are progressively downsampled.
While this retains the entire history, aggressive spatial compression reduces detail, leading to weaker long-range reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
FramePack [53]应用于视频翻译的任务,将过去的块存储在几何化的空间分辨率下. 最近的区块保持了完全的分辨率,而更古老的区块则逐渐被下取样.
虽然这保留了整个历史,但咄咄逼人的空间压缩会减少细节,导致远程重建更弱.

blocks.en: Overall, correspondence-based retrieval outperforms all alternative mechanisms for extending temporal context, achieving stronger long-range consistency without sacrificing visual quality.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,基于函证的检索优于扩展时间背景的所有替代机制,在不牺牲视觉质量的情况下实现更强的远程一致性.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis and Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析和缺陷

blocks.en:
First, we show the importance of using correspondence patches through an ablation where we remove the correspondences and disable the correspondence cross-attention layer (Equation 4 ).
As in Table 5 , without using correspondence the long context consistency gets significantly worse. The LPIPS reconstruction improves by 37 % 37\% and 30 % 30\% on the two datasets. DreamSim and CLIP similarity scores are also similarly effected.
Figure 5 shows this qualitatively.
The top row shows the generated video when the correspondence is disabled. In this video, the dog starts with a yellow snout, but as the video progresses and the dog re-enters the scene, the snout turns blue.
In contrast, our full method with correspondence is shown in the bottom row. Here the dog retains the identity and re-enters the scene with the same yellow snout.

首先,我们通过删除信件并禁用信件交叉注意层(第4个方程式)来显示使用信件补丁的重要性。
如表5所示,如果不使用对应数据,则长期上下文的一致性会大大恶化。 在两个数据集上,LPIPS重建改进了37% 37.%和30% 30.%. DreamSim和CLIP的相近性分数也是类似的.

反之,我们与对应的全方法在下行显示. 在这里,狗保留了身份,并用同一种黄色鼻音重新进入现场.

blocks.en:
Next, we show that our method is not specific to any single distillation method. We apply our method to three different distillation methods: SelfForcing [ 12 ] , LongLive [ 47 ] , and RollingForcing [ 22 ] .
Add our correspondence method improves the consistency across each of the base distillation methods as seen in Table 3 .

接下来,我们显示我们的方法并不是任何单一的蒸馏方法所特有的. 我们把方法应用于三种不同的蒸馏方法:自取自出[12],自取自出[47],自取自出[22].

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en:
We introduce vid2vid-long , a correspondence-based memory mechanism for long-range consistent video-to-video translation. By exploiting a structural property of the task, matching regions in the input should match in the output, we replace implicit long-range attention with explicit input-driven retrieval.
Our dynamic memory grows with visual novelty rather than length of the video, enabling sub-linear scaling while preserving real-time performance.
Across multiple autoregressive distillation backbones, our method consistently improves long-range reconstruction and reduces identity drift while maintaining high visual quality and real-time inference performance.
Compared to alternative context extension strategies, explicit correspondence retrieval proves both more effective and more efficient.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了vid2vid-long,一种基于函授的记忆机制,用于远程一致的视频到视频翻译. 通过利用任务的结构属性,将输入中的区域匹配到产出中,我们用明确的输入驱动检索取代隐含的长距离注意.
我们的活性记忆随着视频的视觉新颖性而不是长度而增长,在保持实时性能的同时,可以实现子线性缩放.
我们的方法跨越了多个自旋蒸馏主干线,不断改进了远程重建并减少了身份漂移,同时保持了高视觉质量和实时推论性能.
与备选上下文扩展战略相比,清晰的函文检索证明既有效又高效.

blocks.en: Our model struggles on fast videos with large motion, where reliable cross-frame correspondences become harder to establish. It can also fail when the text prompt is inconsistent with the input depth video, since the model must reconcile conflicting semantic and structural conditioning signals.

blocks.en: B History Growth Analysis
blocks.zh: B. 历史增长分析

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 3 of the main paper, the memory footprint scales with the visual novelty of the scene rather than the raw sequence length. Here, we empirically validate this claim.
blocks.zh: 如"正文"第3节所讨论,记忆足迹以场景的视觉新颖性而不是原始序列长度来缩放. 在这里,我们从经验上证实了这一说法。

blocks.en:
Table 6 compares the total GPU memory footprint of a naive full KV-cache approach against our dynamic memory mechanism as video length increases.
The naive approach retains KV entries for every past token across all 45 transformer layers, causing memory to grow linearly with sequence length. At 480p resolution, it exceeds the 80 GB capacity of an H100 GPU after roughly 30 seconds; at 720p the limit is reached even sooner.
Our method replaces the large KV cache with an attention sink and a fixed-size sliding window ( W = 21 W{=}21 latent frames), plus a correspondence memory that stores only input–output latent patch pairs.
Because the correspondence memory bypasses the per-layer KV overhead, its footprint is negligible: even after 10 minutes of video (9,600 frames), total VRAM increases by only 0.1 GB at 480p and 0.3 GB at 720p compared to the initial cost.
As a result, total VRAM remains nearly constant regardless of video duration at both resolutions.

我们的方法将大型 KV 缓存替换为注意槽和一个固定大小的滑动窗口( W = 21 W{=}21 潜在框架), 外加只存储输入- 输出潜在补丁对的函证内存 。
由于函证内存绕过每层KV的俯冲,其足迹可忽略不计:即使经过了10分钟的视频(9,600帧)后,与初始成本相比,总VRAM在480p时只增加了0.1GB,而0.3GB则增加了720p.
因此,不论两项决议的录像时间长短,总的VRAM几乎保持不变。

blocks.en:
Table 9 lists all training and model hyperparameters.
We train the student model using Rolling Forcing [ 22 ] distillation with 5 uniformly spaced denoising steps ( { 1000,800,600,400,200 } \{1000,800,600,400,200\} ) that are shifted following standard practice.
The student is initialized from the pretrained VACE 1.3B checkpoint and all parameters are finetuned jointly, including the newly introduced correspondence cross-attention layers.
The student is initialized with Diffusion Forcing training before timestep distillation.
The teacher is the bidirectional VACE 14B model and does not use correspondence memory.
During training, the correspondence memory is active: for each rollout, memory read and write operations are performed as described in Section 3.2 of the main paper.
We use the standard Rolling Forcing objective without modification or additional loss terms.
We apply EMA with weight 0.99 starting at iteration 200. Training uses mixed precision and gradient checkpointing on 32 A100 80GB GPUs across 4 nodes. All inference benchmarks are measured on a single H100 80GB GPU.

Algorithm 1 provides the complete inference procedure.
The model processes the input conditioning video block-by-block.
For each block, we retrieve matching past outputs from the correspondence memory ( memory read ), denoise with correspondence cross-attention conditioning, and update the memory with novel input-output pairs ( memory write ).
Retrieval is performed once per block and the retrieved tokens are reused across all denoising steps.

blocks.en: G Dataset Details and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: G 数据集细节和预处理

blocks.en:
We follow the standard VACE-Benchmark [ 14 ] evaluation protocol for video preprocessing: each source video is uniformly sampled to 81 frames and resized to 480 × 832 480{\times}832 with center cropping.
We retain all source videos with at least 81 frames.
To evaluate long-range consistency, we follow the concatenation protocol of [ 9 ] and construct 100 evaluation sequences (with a fixed random seed) by randomly pairing two source clips and concatenating them in an A → \rightarrow B → \rightarrow A → \rightarrow B order, yielding 4 × 81 = 324 4{\times}81{=}324 frames per sequence at 16 fps ( ∼ {\sim} 20 seconds).
The repeated structure produces ground-truth correspondence pairs, where each pair maps a frame in the first occurrence of a clip to the same frame in its second occurrence.
Conditioning signals (depth maps, optical flow, and scribble maps) are extracted using the official VACE annotators applied to the concatenated sequence.
Text captions are obtained from the original VACE-Benchmark English prompts and stylized into five artistic variants per clip using Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct.

blocks.en:
We use the DL3DV-10K dataset [ 21 ] to evaluate long-range consistency under controlled, geometry-grounded viewpoint revisits.
We select scenes spanning diverse indoor and outdoor environments from the DL3DV-GS-960P split, which provides calibrated COLMAP camera poses and pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models [ 15 ] .
For each scene, we construct a 60-second looping video (960 frames at 16 fps) as follows.
We first extract the first loop from the camera trajectory by finding the point where the camera first returns closest to its starting position after traveling at least 25% of the total path length.
The last 20 cameras are smoothly blended toward the initial camera (linear interpolation for translation, SLERP for rotation) to close the loop.
The overlap segment yields ground-truth correspondence pairs per scene, with each pair separated by approximately 48 seconds.
Conditioning signals are extracted using the same VACE annotator pipeline as VACE-Benchmark.
Text captions are generated by captioning the first rendered frame with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and stylizing into five variants with Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct.
This dataset contains 180 samples in total.
